title: Bug : Medtrum manual bolus progression window
symptom: When using manual bolus with Medtrum Nano pump, the bolus progression window initially shows the amount injected with the last bolus/SMB, then after 1 second shows the actual bolus being delivered, and then disappears after a few seconds. Tapping the line at the bottom of the UI does not bring it back.
cause: The issue is Medtrum-specific and comes from NotificationPacket::handleNormalBolus where at start of a new bolus as a first message is sent result of last bolus (bolusCompleted = true, bolusDelivered = size_of_last_bolus).
fix: The fix is in PR #4364 which resets the Medtrum bolus progress to zero when starting a bolus. This was merged by MilosKozak.
evidence_quote: It's metrum specific and it comes from: `NotificationPacket::handleNormalBolus` where at start of a new bolus as a first message is sent result of last bolus ie: `bolusCompleted = true` `bolusDelivered = size_of_last_bolus`
